summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest 15/15) and frontend (Playwright end-to-end) testing of FlowCRM multi-tenant CRM SaaS. All critical flows work: owner login, dashboard KPIs (8 leads, $40k pipeline, 33.3% conv, revenue chart, source pie), full sidebar navigation across 24 routes with no failures, Leads CRUD via ResourcePage, Pipeline Kanban (8 stage columns) with deal creation, Invoice creation with automatic tax total ($1000+$100=$1100), Projects create + milestone add, Website Connections + Forms pages render, AI Assistant returns grounded reply, Settings branding button present, Reports has 7 CSV export buttons. Client role isolation verified: client@demo.com is routed to Client Portal (Nimbus Retail welcome screen with projects/invoices/tasks), and hitting /leads shows portal (not Leads table). Backend org isolation, deal_won automation, and public tracking JS all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 894 lines - consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, crud, ai, automations, public) for maintainability

Client role isolation is done via build_scope on generic CRUD - explicit resources like /api/dashboard/stats and /api/analytics/overview do not appear to enforce client role restrictions (client role should probably be blocked or scoped there too)
ResourcePage select trigger and input share the same data-testid pattern (field-{name}) - fine but be aware for testing with role='combobox'
Frontend uses Bearer token in localStorage (per design) - acceptable but consider XSS mitigation
test_credentials: Owner glennmuyskens78776@outlook.com / Admin@12345; Client client@demo.com / Client@12345 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md)
seed_data_creation: Tests create UITEST_/TEST_ prefixed records (Lead, Deal, Invoice, Project) and a new org via /auth/register with random email; owner-created UI records left in DB
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env at import time. Run with: cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -o addopts='' (pytest.ini enables xdist by default which breaks single-file runs without -o addopts=''). All 15 tests pass in ~9s.
